_comment: Behavioral kept-red proof for #1484. The real scanDrawerSurfaces enumerates its fixture directory, beforeStat deletes DRAWER_RACE_PROOF_FIXTURE.filePath before the real stat, and the named assertion requires the unfixed ENOENT to propagate. Corrected code fails this assertion with AssertionError. No surviving mutation was found: (1) drawer isEnoent => false makes the named drawer test pass; (2) drawer stat-catch classification changed from isEnoent(error) to false makes the named drawer test pass; (3) translation isEnoent => false makes the companion named translation test pass.

expectedRed.testName: drawer scanner propagates the unfixed ENOENT race
expectedRed.why: The exact reproducing path is scanDrawerSurfaces → fixture enumeration → beforeStat deletion of DRAWER_RACE_PROOF_FIXTURE.filePath → real stat. The corrected ENOENT recovery makes the assertion fail; changing the drawer isEnoent classifier or the drawer stat catch to false makes this named assertion pass, so the paired runner detects either restored bug.
